findings.summary: T0 through T5 are described as five tiers although the pinned ARK registry declares six tier IDs.
Recovery is presented as a sequential ladder more strongly than ARK MRS permits.
Some prose uses SHA-256 digest matching as proof of authenticity, authorship, or cryptographic signing.
The ZIP contains nine files but its internal SHA256SUMS lists six while verification prose says all nine should verify.
The report says Phase 1 complete or production ready although the newborn repository initially contained only LICENSE and a minimal README.
